command: const fs=require('fs');const todo=['/app'];const found=[];while(todo.length){let p=todo.pop();for(const e of fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())todo.push(f);else if(e.isFile()&&e.name==='package.json'){try{const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));if(m.name==='minimatch'||m.name==='typescript-eslint'||(m.name||'').startsWith('@typescript-eslint/'))found.push({path:f,name:m.name,version:m.version});}catch{}}}}console.log(JSON.stringify({node:process.version,inspectedRoot:'/app',matchingPackages:found},null,2));
